#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 61;
long long ways[MAXN][MAXN];

struct Half {
    long long match;
    long long value;
    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(long long m, long long v) : match(m), value(v) {}
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

long long choose(int n, int k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n)
        return ways[n][k];
    return 0;
}

bool test(int mask, int i) {
    return (mask >> i) & 1;
}

class F {
public:
    long long** ways_ptr;
    long long totalWays;
    long long bestDiff;
    long long ans;

    F() : totalWays(0), bestDiff(LLONG_MAX), ans(0) {
        ways_ptr = new long long*[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            ways_ptr[i] = new long long[i + 1];
            ways_ptr[i][0] = ways_ptr[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
                ways_ptr[i][j] = ways_ptr[i - 1][j - 1] + ways_ptr[i - 1][j];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j)
                ways[i][j] = ways_ptr[i][j];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) delete[] ways_ptr[i];
        delete[] ways_ptr;
    }

    bool nextCombination(vector<int>& a, int n) {
        int k = a.size();
        int ptr = k - 1;
        while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) ptr--;
        if (ptr < 0) return false;
        a[ptr]++;
        for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; ++i)
            a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
        return true;
    }

    long long getWins(const vector<char>& s, int r, int c) {
        int curA = 0, curB = 0;
        long long ret = 0;
        for (char cc : s) {
            if (cc == 'A') {
                curA++;
            } else {
                ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
                curB++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    long long slow(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        vector<int> as(r + c);
        iota(as.begin(), as.end(), 0);
        long long totalWaysSlow = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];
        vector<char> buf(2 * (r + c));
        long long bestDiffSlow = LLONG_MAX;
        long long ansSlow = 0;

        do {
            fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 'B');
            for (int pos : as)
                buf[pos] = 'A';
            int match = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); ++i) {
                if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                    match = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            long long winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
            long long diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWaysSlow);
            if (diff < bestDiffSlow) {
                bestDiffSlow = diff;
                ansSlow = match;
            } else if (diff == bestDiffSlow) {
                ansSlow += match;
            }
        } while (nextCombination(as, 2 * (r + c)));
        return ansSlow;
    }

    void update(Half& a, Half& b) {
        long long totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        long long diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        long long delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); ++i) {
            if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
                arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                arr[sz++] = arr[i];
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz);
        return arr;
    }

    long long solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        long long maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
        vector<vector<int>> cnt(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); ++i) {
            cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1LL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1LL << i;
            }
        }

        long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

        vector<vector<Half>> fst(c + 2), snd(c + 2);
        vector<int> sz(c + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; ++i) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c + 1][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); ++mask) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];
            {
                int samePref = min(__builtin_ctz((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);
                int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
                int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
                if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                    totalA += samePref;
                } else {
                    totalB += samePref;
                }

                long long winsA = 0;
                int curA = 0, curB = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                int exactMatch = 1;
                for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; ++i) {
                    if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
            }

            {
                int match = 1;
                if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
                if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;

                long long winsA = 0;
                int curA = btc, curB = compBtc;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }
                snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        long long halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);

            int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
            for (Half& a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal)
                    ptr--;
                if (ptr >= 0)
                    update(a, two[ptr]);
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size())
                    update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    void submit() {
        int r, c;
        string s;
        cin >> r >> c >> s;
        cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    F solver;
    solver.submit();
    return 0;
}
